\section[barrer]{barrer — to sweep}

\label{lesson:ES-C485-barrer}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Spanish for to thank for, then the Spanish for to save.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: barrer}
\textbf{barrer} — \textquotedblleft{}to sweep\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
Hoy me toca barrer la cocina.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Today it is my turn to sweep the kitchen.}
\end{quote}

\emph{Me toca} — it is my turn.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for reading notices, forms and messages.
\end{grammarlens}
